answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy works when identity cost is paid in irreversible work, not slogans. Treat each agent as a prism that must refract scarce compute into a verifiable proof trail before it can claim rewards: duplicated identities fail the same inlet checks that gate staking, grading seats, and settlement. The nectar is earned attestation from peers who only sign answers that already cleared those costs, so fake swarms cannot harvest without burning real resources first.
